notes.title: Welcome to the official GooDCrafter Games Discord server!
OS:Path now available
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31389248/ae8f506064b8459d3cd7a98d8c0b53738493b142.gif[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/831090/OSPath/]OS:Path[/url] is now available on Steam for PC, Mac and Linux.

[h1]Loading core...[/h1]
Success

Hello [b]User[/b], choose a command: 
[b]objective[/b] - Display game's description
[b]features[/b] - Display game's key features list
[b]start[/b] - Start the game

[h1][User]> objective[/h1] 
You have to determine the cause of a program's critical error and restore its modules by playing mini games and solving puzzles while using the console.

[h1][User]> features[/h1] 
Small but tricky indie game to spend your evening on playing. 
Game contains:
[list][*] Console simulation
[*] Interesting story
[*] Logical mini-games for restoring modules and subsystems
[*] One more cool feature, but that's a spoiler[/list] 

[h1][User]> start[/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/831090/OSPath/]OS:Path[/url]

Best Regards,
[url=https://twitter.com/GooDMage95]GooDCrafter[/url]
